title: Thread — rasa.module.messages (records-family/1)
description: A conversation: one directory messages/<channel>/THR-nnnn-<slug>/ holding this record (THR-nnnn.md, titled by its H1: the subject for email and letters, the people for texts, chat and calls), one file per message beside it, and an attachments/ directory. The channel is the directory the thread sits in; there is no channel key. Needs-reply, unseen and waiting are derived from the messages, never stored here.

id.description: Minted by the messages tool; never reused. The thread directory is named THR-nnnn-<slug> and holds this record as THR-nnnn.md.

updated.description: Bumped by every tool edit; `messages touch` after a hand edit.

who.x-not-message: a participant is an address or a CARD id, never another kind of record
who.description: The address the conversation is with, as used (or a CARD id). Its form must suit the thread's channel.

name.description: A display name as the message or the file carried it. Contact cards are resolved at view time, never copied in.

participants.description: The other people in the conversation (never your own identities). Kept by the tool as messages are added.

identity.description: Which of your declared identities (config `identities[].id`) this conversation is conducted as. Replies default to it.

labels.description: Many-to-many labels. Declare to constrain: config `labels`.

account.description: The business account the conversation belongs to (rasa.module.crm).

about.description: What the conversation is about: any family record (EVT-, LEAD-, NOTE-, TASK-...).

pinned.description: Only ever `true`; an unpinned thread omits the key.
